name: object-based-ilp-1d-arc — Cloud Agent VPS: 4×Xeon vCPU, 15GiB RAM, 0 swap, ~252G disk, Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 (KVM)
install:
sudo apt-get update -qq
sudo apt-get install -y -qq parallel
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip
.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
.venv/bin/pip install -e ./popper
.venv/bin/pip install pytest
